name: Rose Glass
referenceCoordinateMapping: With output UV measured from the top-left, map the 9:16 canvas to p = vec2(uv.x * 720 - 65, uv.y * 1280). The 590 x 1280 material space has 65 reference pixels of extra backdrop on each side. PNG layer UV is ((p.x + 65) / 720, p.y / 1280); SVG mask UV is (p.x / 590, p.y / 1280).

composition.shapeAuthority: The four PNG textures define the resting visible contour and material only. The three SVG masks support picking and undeformed shape. For interaction, evaluate the selected body's shape, material, shadow and blur at inverse-deformed coordinates in depth order; do not warp the signed scene deltas.
composition.sizeSemantics: halfSize is the distance from center to the analytic material-coordinate boundary. Normalize with q = localPoint / halfSize; never divide halfSize by 2 again.

automaticLight.verificationNote: The mixed frequencies form a non-closed orbit. Compare the four specified times instead of waiting for one loop.

interactionDefaults.recoverySettledMetric: hypot(displacementX, displacementY, velocityX, velocityY, indentation * 100, indentationVelocity * 100)

rendering.restingPass: compose base plate and three signed color deltas at the same unwarped screen coordinate for an exact static reference
rendering.interactiveMainPass: sample each body's independent black/white material response and shadow maps at its own inverse-deformed coordinate, then compose over the current underlayer with strain-based light and thickness corrections
rendering.resolvePass: apply progressive edge diffusion after depth-aware material composition
rendering.dynamicMaterialScaleCount: Count both held grips and released grips whose deformation has not settled. fieldCount / substepsPerContact is an equivalent count.
rendering.materialBufferRounding: round(outputPixels * dynamicMaterialScale) independently for width and height
rendering.materialBufferResize: The grip count is an integer and remains unchanged throughout recovery, then drops when the settled metric is at or below its epsilon. Resize immediately when that integer changes; no hysteresis is required. Clamp each dimension to at least 1 pixel.

visualTargets.foreground: Nearly fills the width from x 29 to 567. Keep a dark rose shoulder across the upper-left and right edge, a peach center, and a cream highlight toward the lower-left.
visualTargets.upper: Cropped by the top edge, darker on the upper/right rim, softly rose-tinted inside.
visualTargets.lower: Cropped by the bottom and both side edges, mostly milky cream with a darker mauve rim.
visualTargets.edgeOptics: Blur and absorption must vary with local optical thickness; do not draw a constant-width outline or apply one uniform blur radius.
visualTargets.overlap: Foreground glass casts a close dark contact shadow and a broader rose penumbra onto both rear bodies.

debug.runtimeContract: Expose window.__roseGlassDebug with activePointers:number, activeAndRecoveringGrips:number, deformationFieldCount:number, byBody:[upperActivePointers,lowerActivePointers,foregroundActivePointers], materialFramebuffer:[w,h], output:[w,h], guiVisible:boolean, and lightSeconds:number measured from the first rendered frame. deformationFieldCount equals activeAndRecoveringGrips * substepsPerContact.
